pumac-2009-combinatorics-a-08.prompt: Taotao wants to buy a bracelet. The bracelets have 7 beads on them, arranged in a circle. Two bracelets are the same if one can be rotated or flipped to get the other. If she can choose the colors and placement of the beads, and the beads come in orange, white, and black, how many possible bracelets can she buy?
